title: The Truman Show's theme on religion from an Islamic perspective

commenti.body: from a Buddhist perspective, Truman was gonna learn that he'd have to deal with reruns...over and over...til he figured out how to unionize...and get a collective bargaining agreement that'd let him share in the profits...so he could build up enough eff u bank...so he could leave on his terms...and go out there to learn what he shoulda been learning...existence is (unmanaged) suffering!
